statement: Consider a cyclic weighted graph with 13 nonempty layers, one to four vertices per layer, and edges only within layers or between consecutive layers. Assume the graph is K_7-free, every vertex has weighted open-neighborhood at least one, all vertex weights are nonnegative, and exactly one cyclic layer boundary has adjacent layer-cardinality sum at least seven. Then the total vertex weight is at least 4154/851, which is strictly greater than 39/8.
contribution: An exact computer-assisted obstruction eliminates every one-high-boundary instance of the previously unclassified arbitrary-edge four-slot layered construction. Dihedral and within-layer symmetry, edge-maximal K_7-free topology classification, and coordinatewise count dominance reduce the class to 480 LPs, each supported by an exactly checked rational dual certificate. This is a strict subsidiary layered-class result and does not settle the unrestricted original problem.
